# Outdoor Trail Maps

> > Comprehensive trail maps and guides for Colorado's 14ers, wilderness areas, and hunting units (GMUs).

Outdoor Trail Maps provides detailed topographic maps, route information, and access guides for Colorado's mountain peaks, wilderness areas, and Game Management Units. The site serves hikers, climbers, mountaineers, and hunters exploring Colorado's backcountry from the Sangre de Cristo Range to Eagles Nest Wilderness.

## Key Topics

- Colorado 14ers
- Wilderness maps
- Colorado hunting units (GMUs)
- Trail maps and hiking routes
- Mount Bierstadt and Mount Evans
- Grays Peak and Torreys Peak
- Crestone Peak and Crestone Needle
- Eagles Nest Wilderness
- Holy Cross Wilderness
- Lost Creek Wilderness
- Vail and Vail Pass area
- Class 3 scrambling routes
- Mountaineering guides
- Trailhead access information
- Sangre de Cristo Range

## Colorado 14ers & Peak Hiking

- [Crestone Peak and Crestone Needle](https://www.outdoortrailmaps.com/crestone-peak-14294-ft-crestone-needle-14197-ft): Crestone Peak & Needle 14ers in Sangre de Cristo Range trail info & maps

## Colorado Hunting Units (GMUs)

- [CO-GMU 36](https://www.outdoortrailmaps.com/co-gmu-36): Colorado GMU 36 hunting unit map covering Vail, Eagles Nest & Holy Cross
- [CO-GMU 1](https://www.outdoortrailmaps.com/co-gmu-1): Colorado GMU 1 hunting unit map near Dinosaur National Monument
